infectionStatus.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

value.zh: 参照医学检测报告，确认为感染者。

text.en: The leader of the Glasgow Gang's fighters in Victoria. During the war, she fought courageously alongside Vina Victoria and the Exemplars. After the war, she returned to Norport to continue running the Slobberknocker boxing gym. As one of our main points of contact at Rhodes Island's Victoria office, she is often invited to participate in practical combat training (essentially serving as a sparring partner) and occasionally helps Vina Victoria deliver messages back to Rhodes Island.
text.zh: 维多利亚格拉斯哥帮武斗派头目。战争时期，跟随维娜·维多利亚参与了典范军的行动，表现英勇。战后回到了诺伯特区继续经营“揍歪下巴”拳馆。罗德岛驻维多利亚办事处的联络人之一，经常会被邀请参与一些实战指导的工作（其实就是实战训练的对手），偶尔也会替维娜·维多利亚回罗德岛传递消息。

text.en:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 9%
No visible Originium crystals have been observed on the surface of Indra's body. Though her disease is currently under control, she needs to be closely monitored.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.19u/L
Indra was injured during operations in Victoria, and became infected after long-term exposure to high levels of Originium particulate concentration.
After the war, she repeatedly refused the specialized physical exams prepared by Medical. Instead, she directed her colleagues, who had come to volunteer as medics, to treat local citizens first. At least three colleagues have raised objections to her indifference towards her own health.
'Tons of Londiniers who need help more than I do. 'Sides, I have to book a checkup at some point, else Vina'll duff me up. Again.'
——Operator Indra's reply
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓模糊，可见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测异常，有矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】9%
干员因陀罗体表尚未发现源石结晶分布，虽然其病情已经得到了控制，但仍需要密切关注。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.19u/L
干员因陀罗在维多利亚的行动中受伤，且长时间暴露在源石粉尘浓度过高的危险环境中导致了感染。
战后，因陀罗总是推掉医疗部为她准备的专项体检，拉着来到伦蒂尼姆的同事支援当地的医疗服务。已经有至少三名同事因为因陀罗对自身病情无所谓的态度提出了异议。
“伦蒂尼姆还有很多比我更需要你们的人！再说，我自己会抽空回本舰检查的，不然维娜又要揍我了。”
——干员因陀罗的回复

text.en: Technique was not what allowed her to survive for years on the street, but rather raw force and combat instincts. She developed into a great fighter through street brawling since childhood, and her confidence in her own two powerful fists enabled her to defeat countless foes.
text.zh: 因陀罗在街头混迹多年依靠的并不是某种拳术，而是单纯的体格和战斗直感。从小混迹于斗殴的街头给因陀罗带来了很强的战斗本能，而她也是相信着自己这纯粹的强大的双拳，一步一步击败了无数对手。

text.en: Glasgow hung out in the slums of Victoria, getting their start as a street gang led by Morgan and Indra. They carved out their turf and survived in the anarchy, until Siege showed up and handed the supremely confident Indra her first ever defeat.
text.zh: 格拉斯哥帮混迹于维多利亚的贫民区，最开始本身是由摩根和因陀罗带领的街头组织。她们霸占了一方的地盘，为了生存过着混乱的生活，直到推进之王出现在了她们面前。对力量有着绝对自信的因陀罗在面对推进之王时第一次尝到了败北的滋味。

text.en: It wasn't just a simple defeat, since Siege's character and vision converted both Indra and Morgan into loyal friends and cohorts. Even though Siege never liked to pull rank, Indra still saw herself as Siege's most devoted follower and would do anything for her. Who knew a thug too lazy to be bothered with the concept of knighthood would exemplify the spirit far more than the official knights of Kazimierz?
text.zh: 并不是单纯的因为输了，而是因为推进之王的人格和目标，因陀罗和摩根一起成为了其忠诚的下属和朋友。虽然推进之王自己不喜欢上下级关系，但是对因陀罗来说，自己就是推进之王最忠诚的下属，为其奉献一切。谁又能想到，一个连骑士精神是啥都懒得理解的混混，却远比卡西米尔国内的政府骑士更为纯粹?

text.en: The straightforward Indra hates sly, glib people who play games. Face to face, out in the open, that's what fighting is all about! Only cowards would act like a weasel! Her bold personality has made many like-minded colleagues her buddies at Rhodes Island. They would spar and discuss battles in the gym, then go for a big feast together after a sweaty workout and mock the supposedly 'brainy' Operators behind their backs. What else could be better than this in life?
text.zh: 直来直去的因陀罗最不喜欢的就是油腔滑调的人，耍什么心机，耍什么计谋，战斗不就是要面对面地正面对决吗?只有胆小鬼才会想这些东西！这样的性格让因陀罗在罗德岛和不少豪爽的干员成为了好友，大家会在练习房中切磋战斗经验，流了汗之后再去豪爽地大吃大喝一番，再说说那些智力派干员的坏话，人生诸事还有什么比这更畅快？
